referenceEncoder.name: cbV2G
referenceEncoder.note: Wire-conformant ISO 15118-20 CommonMessages reference. Each vector is a fixed message emitted by tools/cbv2g-ref/main_iso20.c (build: tools/cbv2g-ref/build.sh, run: cbv2g_iso20 Common_<name>). Header SessionID is 8x0x00, TimeStamp=1700000000, no Signature. The C# test builds the matching message via Iso15118_20CommonFixtures and diffs its bytes.
